skills.description_zh:
An equity research framework for innovative drugs and biopharma. Built on a four-question spine — Does it work? What is it worth? Who else is doing it? Can the data be trusted? — covering clinical readout timing and win thresholds, two-part rNPV valuation, molecular mechanism benchmarking, and three-tier source grading. Ships with three mandatory hard checks and a numeric self-consistency audit, producing Chinese research reports a skeptical peer can actually re-derive.
